reviews.title: Pro Membership is a waste of money!
reviews.text: I recently traded and purchased a new iPhone.  When I reinstalled Reading List, Apple charged me again even though I had previously purchased a Pro Membership Lifetime!  I also had Reading List installed on another device, which according to the FAQs, should be a free install on other devices, but that too didn’t work.  Developer has also been non responsive so app may no longer be actively supported.

reviews.title: Love this app usually
reviews.text: Love this app usually but right now I can’t add any more books either using the scan ISBN function or the Search Online function, it comes up with an error message

reviews.title: Downhill
reviews.text: It’s gone downhill too many bugs and now the scanning features has stopped working.

reviews.title: Progress bar issue
reviews.text: Only complaint is that the progress bar is missing from most books I add nowadays. Otherwise great and very useful app.

reviews.title: Scanning functionality no longer works
reviews.text: The scanning barcode functionality does not work at all anymore.  Every book now needs to be added manually.  I will probably be switching to a different app if this is not fixed.

reviews.title: Widgets are not working
reviews.text: I’m having trouble with the widgets not working as they used to. The suggested widget from Apple shows the book I’m currently reading, but when I add to Home Screen it only shows ‘add books’ on the widget. When I got it to work earlier, the percentage on the widget wasn’t updating.

reviews.title: Inputting myself
reviews.text: Not sure what happened but it seems like any book I am reading/listening too I have to enter manually now. Even scanning its like no books can be found. Pretty frustrating.

reviews.title: It’s nice ..but..
reviews.text: Been using this app for a while. I like it … but the widget doesn’t work anymore. Kind of makes me not want to use it anymore.

reviews.title: Will not work for me
reviews.text: I downloaded this app because it was recommended by a book BESTIE on TikTok, and the app will not allow me to upload any books while using the camera. It’ll scan the barcode and says that it can’t find the book or it just simply doesn’t exist. I restarted my phone because the camera wasn’t turning on before, I deleted the app and redownloaded it, I even paid for the yearly subscription. Nothing is working. So I give up. This would have been a cool app to have to scan all of my books in.

reviews.title: Not Worth The Renewal Subscription
reviews.text:
I am not sure why all the rave reviews, what am I missing. This app is rudimentary at best. The note section needs much improvement in the copy and paste function. Each time you copy a note from a book and try to paste it in a running stream of already inserted notes, the app scrolls you back to mid-section of the screen and then you have to scroll down to your insertion section.Frustrating.  

Also there is no auto save like you have in Apple Notes or Microsoft OneNote. If you forget to save your recently inserted notes and the app times out, all is lost. 

I would have renewed my subscription, but it’s just not worth it.
